title: Normalization of the constructed constant derived unit
statement: For a finite commutative ring A and an arbitrary scheme S, the constructed isomorphism constantUnit A S equals the canonical singleFunctorObjUnitIso for module sheaves. In particular its additional constant-sheaf monoidal-unit factor is the identity.

source.place: The constant-unit comparison in the coordinate trace; canonical constant-sheaf and derived monoidal-unit maps.

proof.text: The unit map of the constant-sheaf functor is the sheafification of the identity of the constant coefficient unit, hence is the identity. Its inverse is the identity by cancellation. The degree-zero functor preserves this identity, so the remaining factor in constantUnit is singleFunctorObjUnitIso.
